neighbours.label: Human potential as a collective resource that is lost or must be nurtured: human capital, 'our future', lost productivity, wasted or unlocked potential of people
fire: Economists warned that the brain drain amounted to a slow haemorrhage of human capital.
Every child who dies of malaria is a loss of potential that the whole country pays for.
These students are the future of the nation, and we cannot afford to waste a single one.
Chronic illness drains an economy through lost productivity long before it shows up in hospital bills.
Years of conflict have squandered the talents of an entire generation of young people.
The scholarship fund exists to nurture the potential of children from poor villages.
Early retirement of skilled workers represents a real loss of productive capacity for the region.
The report measured the lost earnings of girls who never finished secondary school.
quiet: Economists warned that the devaluation amounted to a slow haemorrhage of foreign reserves.
Every tree that dies of blight is a loss of timber that the whole mill pays for.
These bonds mature in the future, and we cannot afford to sell a single one early.
Rust drains a car's value long before the engine shows any sign of trouble.
Years of drought have emptied the reservoirs of an entire province.
The repair fund exists to maintain the bridges of the poorer villages.
Early closure of the mine represents a real loss of tax revenue for the region.
The report measured the lost rainfall of regions that never recovered from the drought.

predictions: Fire median ~0.55 (probe: human capital 0.81, potential of a community 0.86, our future 0.61, lost productivity 0.44). Near misses with loss/capital/future/potential in non-human senses <=0.1 (probe <=0.02); 'loss of tax revenue' the likeliest leak.
